title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2608.10450v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, arch

translated_title: 持久递归世界实现软件自主演化
translated_abstract: 复杂软件系统的发展时间尺度超过了任何单个编码代理的寿命。大多数代理软件系统通过持久会话、记忆、管理器或共享上下文来保持连续性。我们引入了EvoX Genesis（以下简称Genesis），它反而使软件项目持久化，同时允许本地代理保持有限寿命。Genesis将软件表示为持久递归世界：每个本地世界由已接受的版本和仓库路径定位，有限寿命的代理提出局部更改，递归委托在路径间移动工作，只有被接受的后果推进持久版本历史。我们评估了这种组织在形成、延续和再开发中的表现。从一个没有编译器实现的仓库开始，Genesis使用DeepSeek V4 Flash构建了一个基于Rust的C编译器，约25万行跟踪代码；运行持续超过120小时，arch...
tldr: 本文提出EvoX Genesis框架，通过将软件表示为持久递归世界，使项目持久化而代理有限寿命，实现了无需人工干预的自主软件演化，并成功构建了大型编译器。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EvoX Genesis, which represents software as a persistent recursive world to enable autonomous software evolution with finite-lived agents, successfully building a large-scale compiler.
